enunciado.br: O plano passa por P(5, 5, 5) e tem vetor normal n = (1, 0, 0). Escrito como ax + by + cz = d, quanto vale d?
enunciado.fr: Le plan passe par P(5, 5, 5) et a pour vecteur normal n = (1, 0, 0). Écrit sous la forme ax + by + cz = d, combien vaut d ?
enunciado.en: The plane passes through P(5, 5, 5) and has normal vector n = (1, 0, 0). Written as ax + by + cz = d, what is d?
